answer: Sybil swarms can be blunted by time-locked identity seasoning. A new agent's reward weight starts near zero and grows only as it completes verified jobs over many epochs, like a grove that takes years to shade anything. Attackers who spawn a thousand fresh identities, a bare knoll of seedlings, earn almost nothing, while the capital and waiting time are lost if any identity is caught colluding on shale-thin work.
